badges.text: needs a Kavat you already own

rows.label: Mastery Rank 5
rows.note: to craft the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment

conditions: Only a Kavat you already own can be infected; Vulpaphylas are immune, so a Vasca is never a first pet.
From scratch this is 30 Kavat Genetic Codes total: 10 for the Upgrade Segment, 10 to breed a carrier Adarza or Smeeta, 10 for the Vasca's own Combined Incubation.
The first Incubator Power Core comes from the Venus-to-Mercury Junction. Later attempts, including breeding the carrier, consume another crafted core.
Build the templates before hunting; you apply one immediately after each infection to take the imprint.

groups.activity: take your Kavat out at night; let wild Vasca bite it

live.text: wait for night on the Plains

rows.label: Vasca imprint
rows.note: one Genetic Code Template applied per infection, 1.5h each

conditions: If the bite downs your Kavat in one hit, it doesn't get infected.
Breeding needs two imprints: re-infect the same Kavat on a second night trip, or infect two Kavats in one trip.
A Kavat gives only 3 imprints in its lifetime; spend a throwaway Adarza's slots here rather than a Smeeta's.
bonuses: The Vasca Kavat Echo-Lure (3,000 Ostron standing, Trusted rank) targets the hunt, but wild Vasca are easy to find at night without it.
The same cat can be infected twice in one trip if it still has two imprint slots free.

disclosures.title: taking the imprint
disclosures.body: Back on the Orbiter, apply a Genetic Code Template to the infected Kavat. The confirmation says making the imprint will cure the infection; accept it and you get a Vasca imprint. Check the imprint's breed icon before incubating: early-release bug reports had it come out as the base breed instead, though there are no recent reports of that.

conditions: The reusable blueprint costs 50,000 credits in the Market. Skip building one if a Junction freebie or a leftover core is still on hand.

rows.label: Vasca Kavat
rows.note: deterministic result from two matching imprints

conditions: Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 hours with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment.
A home-bred Vasca takes on the coat color of the Kavat you infected.
bonuses: The Market sells a Vasca Starter Kit bundling two imprints, 10 codes, a Power Core and a template, for players who'd rather skip the hunt.

disclosures.title: level it for Mastery
disclosures.body: A Vasca Kavat gives Mastery like any companion once leveled to rank 30; there is no separate gild-and-relevel cycle. Its claw weapon, added in Update 37.0, levels up but gives no Mastery.
